## Four more carriers, and a distinction this card did not have: ROTTED vs BORN FALSE

Seat: `domain:spec#1` · Session: `session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L`

Two `os-dev` seats working objectui#9706 and objectui#9704 each turned up carriers while inside the files. All verified before being recorded here.

### ⭐ The distinction — two defects behind one symptom

Verified from the API: PR objectui#8799 merged, and PR objectui#8822 — whose file list shows `.changeset/8478-zod-pins-form-layout.md` with status **`added`** — merged **72 minutes later**. ⇒ that body's *"held by in-flight PR objectui#8799"* was **false at the moment it was written**.

| defect | what it needs |
|---|---|
| **ROTTED** — true when written, falsified later by an unrelated merge | a freshness mechanism, or prose that cannot rot |
| **BORN FALSE** — untrue at write time | the author checking before writing; no freshness mechanism would ever have caught it |

⛔ This card originally described only the first. Both symptoms read identically in the published CHANGELOG, which is exactly why they were being counted as one thing.

### New carriers

| carrier | the claim | reading |
|---|---|---|
| `.changeset/8655-object-tree-props-schema-typed.md` | "the two files that would carry it are held by an **in-flight branch**" | pending; says *branch*, not *PR*, so **no PR-number probe reaches it** and there is no number to check it against |
| `.changeset/6519-retired-field-key-strip.md` | a file "which objectui#6489 **owns in flight**" | objectui#6489 is an **issue**, and it is closed — already false, and it will publish |
| `packages/cli/src/__tests__/check-validity-recogniser.test.ts` | source comment: "656 registered types", "505 registered types have no member", introduced as **"Re-measured on this tree"** | the same instrument reads **649** today ⇒ false in the tree. ⚠️ Not on the release deadline — a test comment does not publish verbatim — but it is **the source the objectui#9704 changeset sentence was copied from** |
| `.changeset/8478-zod-pins-complex.md` | "the last file of this card's remainder, which the card now closes" | present tense about objectui#8478 and **TRUE** — recorded as the same carrier shape with no false statement in it, so the shape alone is not the defect |

### Adjacent-spelling census, over the pending declarations

Run by the objectui#9706 dev across the full pending set: `open PR objectui#NNNN` **0**, `PR objectui#NNNN is open` **0**, `currently open` **0**, `pending PR` **1** (past tense, benign), `still open` **11** and `remains open` **7** (this class already adjudicated those as citing open *issues* or unrelated prose), `held by` **6** — of which 4 are benign non-PR uses and 2 are the carriers above.

⚠️ Read that census as a floor. Every spelling in it was guessed; the two new carriers were found **inside the files**, not by any probe, and one of them ("in-flight **branch**") is invisible to every pattern in the list.

### ⭐ Why the existing gate structurally cannot close this

The objectui#9706 dev reached the same conclusion this card records, from the other side: `check:changeset-claims` asks only whether a pending body **names a file the current change touches**. These sentences went false because *other* branches merged while touching nothing in the file at all. ⇒ the gate is not weak here; it is answering a different question. Its own summary line printed **"No pending changeset names a file this change touches"** on that very PR.

⛔ Still not a gate proposal — a new required gate is on the human floor, and both devs and the triage seat each declined to propose one. What this card now holds is the evidence pack: **four rot instances, one born-false instance, one true-but-same-shape control, and a census whose limits are stated.**

⚠️ **This lane shares `.changeset/` with four in-flight PRs right now, which makes the file-level reading the whole safety margin.** The taker re-takes it against the live file lists before writing, ⛔ never against this table — it is a reading of 2026-09-17T19:41Z, not a standing fact. If a pending entry it wants is on that list, it stops and says so rather than editing across another card's PR.

⭐ **The distinction this card exists to draw applies to the repair itself**: an entry that was **TRUE WHEN WRITTEN** and was later falsified by another card's merge is **ROTTED** — it is re-dated and the falsifying card named, ⛔ never silently overwritten, because overwriting erases that it was true. An entry that was **BORN FALSE** is corrected outright. ⛔ The two are not the same repair, and the taker states which one each site is before touching it.

## ⭐ The first probe was ambiguous, and the reason is worth more than the verdict

The obvious probe — the sentence this card exists to retire — read **1 before and 1 after**:

| probe | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `face declares none of them`, counted bare | **1** | **1** |

⛔ That was not reported as 「the sentence is untouched」, and it is not. **A count is INVARIANT UNDER QUOTATION.** The repair deletes the sentence *as an assertion* and re-introduces the same words *as a quotation of a retired assertion*, inside the block that retires it. The string is present on both sides; its **truth-bearing status** inverts completely, and counting cannot see that.

Re-drawn with the surrounding context, which is the instrument that can:

| probe | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `(objectui#6939). The surviving \`ObjectKanbanSchema\` face declares none of them.` — the phrase **in its assertion position** | **1** | **0** |
| `«The surviving \`ObjectKanbanSchema\` face declares none of them» — is retired` — the phrase **as a quotation** | **0** | **1** |
| **[ABSENT CTRL]** `zzqNoSuchQuote` | 0 | 0 |

⇒ the assertion is gone; the words survive only inside their own retirement notice, which is exactly the **ROTTED** repair this card defines — ⛔ the record is not erased, it is dated.

⚠️ This is a fault my own pre-registered probe did not anticipate. I warned this landing about **wrapping**; the trap was **quotation**. ⭐ On a card whose whole subject is a text being corrected, a probe that counts the corrected text is measuring the wrong thing by construction — a repair that quotes what it retires is *indistinguishable from no repair at all* on a bare count.

## The rest, unambiguous

| probe | file | before | after |
|---|---|---|---|
| `is retired, and the two reasons it failed are DIFFERENT` | `8802-…` | 0 | **1** |
| `ROTTED` / `BORN FALSE` | `8802-…` | 0 / 0 | **1 / 1** |
| `Dated reading` | `7322-…` | 0 | **1** |
| `five later cards have since falsified parts of it` | `7322-…` | 0 | **1** |
| `All five **ROTTED**; none was born false` | `7322-…` | 0 | **1** |
| `It is now the union of the two.` — the undated present tense | `7322-…` | **1** | **0** |
| **[LIT CTRL]** `objectui#8801` / `objectui#7322` | each file | 0 / 1 | 1 / 1 |

**Frontmatter byte-identical across the landing**, both files (md5 `9fa322a3796b` and `f103a55ffcd4` on both refs) ⇒ no package's release moved; `check-changeset-overwrite`'s documented case 2.

## What this card established, beyond its own two entries

⭐ **Its own reading of Instance 1 was incomplete, and the implementer refuted it.** That sentence is **ROTTED and BORN FALSE at once** — `columns` and `cardTitle` were falsified after it was written; `titleField` and `allowCollapse` were **already declared on the day it was written**, verified at `adf581278`, the write-time ref. The two halves need opposite repairs, and the landed text states both with a per-key table instead of picking one.

⭐ And the general rule it lands, which the card did not have:

> 「Every reading below therefore carries the date it was taken, and none is restated in the undated present tense — that tense is the construction that rotted, and a re-measurement written in it would only rot again **before this entry publishes**.」

⇒ for a file that publishes **verbatim at an unknown future date**, a fresh measurement in the present tense is ⛔ not a fix; it is the same defect with a newer number. The durable repair is a **dated** reading, or no figure at all.

## Carried forward, ⛔ not closed here

Two siblings the implementer measured and correctly did **not** touch, now filed: **objectui#9726** (the same defect in `ObjectKanban.tsx` source comments — the surface a changeset sentence gets copied FROM) and **objectui#9727** (a derived CANDIDATE set, 154 across 53 entries, ⛔ with the instrument's own false negative on this card's headline site stated).

Dispatch state cleared in the same round: `pm:dispatched` removed, assignee released. The card is closed `completed` by the merge.
